meta.source: Blizzard Game Data journal-encounter + Wowhead tooltip API
meta.readMe: Ability text and damage magnitudes come from Wowhead's tooltip endpoint, which is the only source carrying tuned numbers for this tier -- Blizzard's /data/wow/spell/<id> returns 404 for these ids and the in-game journal text ships 'X' placeholders. A magnitude here is ONE difficulty's value and the endpoint does not say which; cross-check against measured damage taken in profiles/<spec>-<difficulty>.json before quoting it as a Mythic number.

encounter.name: Nymrissa Wavecaller
encounter.description: Nymrissa Wavecaller commands the restless sea itself, concealing her lair beneath shifting tides. Those who dare uncover her sanctuary find her murloc minions eager to answer their mistress' call.

notes.title: Overview
notes.bodyText: Nymrissa Wavecaller creates an [Alluring Bubble] within the grotto that lures nearby murlocs into her grasp. She then summons [Swirling Whirlpools] to break the bubble, empowering murlocs within.
bullets: Nymrissa Wavecaller creates an [Alluring Bubble] within the grotto that lures nearby murlocs into her grasp. She then summons [Swirling Whirlpools] to break the bubble, empowering murlocs within.

notes.title: Tank
notes.bodyText:
$bullet;[Water Jet] inflicts sustained damage to Nymrissa Wavecaller's current target, and removes icy patches of [Lingering Frost].
$bullet;[Alluring Bubble] attracts a large group of Bubblefin Shorerunners to rush toward the giant bubble.

abilities.title: Alluring Bubble
abilities.description:
Nymrissa gathers water from the grotto and forms a massive bubble of swirling liquid.

The bubble entrances curious murlocs, drawing them in.

abilities.title: Pulsing Tides
abilities.description: Bubblefin Berserkers pulse with the power of the deeps, inflicting 375033 Frost damage to all players every 3 sec.

abilities.title: Pop!
abilities.description: The bubble pops, unleashes a surge of pressurized water that inflicts 541714 Frost damage to all players and knocks them away.

abilities.title: Waterfog Shield
abilities.description: The Bubblefin Frostscale projects a watery membrane that reduces the damage taken by nearby murlocs by 99%.

abilities.title: Swirling Whirlpools
abilities.description:
Nymrissa awakens whirlpools within the grotto that surge toward the Alluring Bubble.

The whirlpools inflict 2500220 Frost damage to players in their path.

abilities.title: Chilling Frost
abilities.description:
Nymrissa chills players to the bone, inflicting 166681 Frost damage every 1.5 sec and decreasing their movement speed by 15% for 6 sec.

Each impact leaves behind a Frost Orb at the player's location.

abilities.title: Frost Orb
abilities.description:
A frozen orb that clings to the player when touched, inflicting 172932 Frost damage and an additional 97259 Frost damage every 2 sec for 12 sec. 

Leaves behind Lingering Frost.

abilities.title: Lingering Frost
abilities.description: Inflicting 100009 Frost damage every 1 sec and causes players to slide.

abilities.title: Shatter
abilities.description: The Frost Orb explodes violently if left untouched, inflicting 1000088 Frost damage to all players and an additional 333363 Frost damage every 2 sec for 30 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Frost Burst
abilities.description: The Frost Orb bursts when touched, inflicting 175015 Frost damage to all players.

abilities.title: Iceblade Flurry
abilities.description: Nymrissa empowers her weapon with ice, slashing her current target for 375033 Frost damage every 1 sec for 5 sec.

abilities.title: Water Jet
abilities.description:
Nymrissa condenses surrounding water into a high-pressure jet, blasting her target for 416703 Frost damage every 1 sec and gradually pushing affected players away. The surging water washes away icy patches on the ground. 

Each hit increases damage taken from Water Jet by 20% for 35 sec. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Abyssal Rain
abilities.description:
Nymrissa channels a torrent of water from the crevices above, inflicting 175015  Frost damage every 1 sec for 4 sec.

This rain drenches its victims, inflicting 23335 Frost damage every 2 sec for 24 sec.

abilities.title: Wavecaller's Might
abilities.description: Nymrissa's power swells, increasing her Frost damage by 5%. This effect stacks.

abilities.title: Unending Tides
abilities.description: Nymrissa unleashes a catastrophic surge of water, repeatedly crashing into all players, inflicting 500044 Frost damage every 1 sec.
